system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

You have learned to modify your Starlight’s to becomes beacons of your victory. Your Starlight’s now have two new states they can be in either Starlight Fission or Starlight Fusion. At the beginning of your turn, instead of creating a new Starlight, you can choose to select a currently active Starlight to enter either its Fission or Fusion state. Either form

Starlight Fission. Your Starlight becomes an unstable mass of energy, that bubbles and looks to be going nuclear until the beginning of your next turn, after which, it explodes. All hostile creatures that begin their turn within 20 feet of the chosen Starlight are hit with a wave of chakra fueled radiation, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain Convergence, and either 3 ranks of Dazzled, Weakened, or Concussed. At the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Starlight explodes, filling a 20-foot radius, forcing all creatures in range to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire or lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

Starlight Fusion. You select two active Starlight’s, as they are attracted to one another, and begin to fuse, becoming a super mote until the beginning of your next turn. Select a new point within 120 feet of you, where both Starlight’s converge upon. This new Fused Starlight, glows bright light in a 40-foot radius, and dim light for an additional 40 feet. Effects that originate from this Fused Starlight gain a rank of Mastery to its attack result, and a +1 bonus to its Save DC. You can increase this bonus to 2 ranks of Mastery and a +2 bonus by fusing one additional active Starlight.
